base_ref.title: Callback failure and retry policy v1

diff_evidence.base_excerpt: Protocol v1 retry contract. A 503 response with TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE is retriable. Retry state SCHEDULED and a trusted retry_at mean the sender will make another attempt; wait for that attempt rather than creating a parallel resend. Contact the callback operator only when the attempt limit is reached and the trusted retry state is EXHAUSTED. Correlate response request, event, order and attempt count.
diff_evidence.target_excerpt: Protocol v2 error handling. A 503 response is retriable only when the server records a retryable failure code and a current retry policy. Retry state SCHEDULED with retry_at is still pending. EXHAUSTED is actionable only when attempt_count reaches max_attempts and the failure response digest/event/request all match the current delivery row. This document describes method; current Domain Evidence decides the incident.
